metadata.description: Foreman and other playbooks by Turki Alshuaibi for building and shipping real things with coding agents.

plugins.name: foreman
plugins.description: Foreman by Turki Alshuaibi turns your agent into the foreman of a website build: it interviews you, forces the design and scope decisions, locks a visual system, writes the brief, then builds or hands it over, and verifies, ships and indexes the site. Survey, Blueprint and Stress test modes. A toolbelt of four standalone tools: board, punch list, palette and launch.
